feedback.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$H=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(H) & ={h}_{11}{C}_{11}+{h}_{12}{C}_{12}+{h}_{13}{C}_{13}+{h}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+1\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & ={C}_{12}-{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & 1 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & ∗ & 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & ∗ \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{4+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =-(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|+8\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|)+(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}|-3\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|) \\  & =8\cdot (-1)+(-3)\cdot 1 \\  & =-8-3 \\  & =-11\end{aligned}
$$
